valleys.name: Leadership Valley
valleys.objective: Turn your leadership experiences into clear evidence of impact.

checkpoints.title: Collect Leadership Evidence
checkpoints.description: Document the leadership activities you have participated in.

tasks.title: List your leadership experiences
tasks.description: Write down organizations, projects, teams or initiatives you have led.

tasks.title: Describe your role
tasks.description: Explain what you were responsible for in each leadership experience.

tasks.title: Measure your impact
tasks.description: Add measurable results such as people reached, money raised, projects completed or improvements achieved.

checkpoints.title: Build Your Leadership Stories
checkpoints.description: Prepare strong stories that demonstrate your leadership ability.

tasks.title: Write one STAR story
tasks.description: Describe one leadership experience using Situation, Task, Action and Result.

tasks.title: Explain what you learned
tasks.description: Explain how the experience changed your leadership approach.

valleys.name: Essay Valley
valleys.objective: Build strong scholarship essays that clearly connect your experience, goals and chosen scholarship.

checkpoints.title: Find Your Story
checkpoints.description: Identify the experiences that best demonstrate your motivation, leadership and impact.

tasks.title: Why this scholarship?
tasks.description: Write why you want this scholarship and what you hope to achieve.

tasks.title: Why this university?
tasks.description: Explain why the university and program are relevant to your goals.

checkpoints.title: Write With Evidence
checkpoints.description: Turn your experiences into specific and convincing stories.

tasks.title: Write using the STAR method
tasks.description: Rewrite an important experience using Situation, Task, Action and Result.

tasks.title: Add measurable impact
tasks.description: Include concrete outcomes instead of only describing what you did.

checkpoints.title: Improve Your Draft
checkpoints.description: Review your essay for clarity, evidence and alignment with the scholarship.

tasks.title: Check your story flow
tasks.description: Make sure the essay has a clear beginning, development and conclusion.

tasks.title: Check scholarship alignment
tasks.description: Make sure your experiences and goals directly answer the scholarship criteria.

valleys.name: Application Valley
valleys.objective: Prepare and verify the final scholarship application before submission.

checkpoints.title: Prepare Your Documents
checkpoints.description: Collect and organize all documents required by the scholarship.

tasks.title: Update your CV
tasks.description: Make sure your CV reflects your strongest academic, professional and leadership achievements.

tasks.title: Prepare academic documents
tasks.description: Collect transcripts, certificates and other academic records.

tasks.title: Prepare recommendation letters
tasks.description: Identify referees and request recommendation letters early.

checkpoints.title: Final Application Check
checkpoints.description: Review the complete application before submission.

tasks.title: Check every requirement
tasks.description: Compare your application against the scholarship requirements.

tasks.title: Proofread everything
tasks.description: Check spelling, formatting and consistency across all application materials.

tasks.title: Submit your application
tasks.description: Submit the completed application before the deadline.
